description.value: Taka Ramen and Sushi is an authentic Japanese restaurant in Squamish serving Asahikawa-style ramen whose broth tradition traces back to Takasu, Hokkaido — slow-simmered pork bone broth finished with Hokkaido-style lard to keep the soup hot. The sushi program sources seasonal seafood from local BC suppliers and the Toyosu Fish Market in Tokyo, prepared by an executive chef with over 30 years of experience. Outdoor seating and a dedicated vegetarian/vegan menu make it a welcoming stop for touring cyclists on the Sea-to-Sky corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (8 spaces, covered) at 68m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is open at 38065 Cleveland Ave, Squamish BC, with phone (604) 390-0077. The veggie menu page explicitly lists vegan ramen and gluten-free gyoza, and a 'to-go is wrapped to keep seaweed crispy' note confirms takeout. No website or OSM evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or charging amenities. OSM lists the business name as 'Taka Ramen and Sushi' while the website consistently uses 'Taka Ramen + Sushi' — flagged in concerns but OSM name retained per rules.
concerns: OSM name is 'Taka Ramen and Sushi' but website consistently uses 'Taka Ramen + Sushi' (ampersand vs. 'and').
OSM record has no address or phone populated — values sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed fields are null for those.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active restaurant in Squamish with a confirmed address and website — clearly useful to touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated Veggie Menu page; vegan ramen with fully vegetable-based broth; Gluten Free Vegetable Gyoza (rice flour-based) explicitly listed on regular menu
